subject: Linkage Disequilibrium - tests for multiple comparison

messages.author: f5e1b987d7a5dc80
messages.subject: Linkage Disequilibrium - tests for multiple comparison
parts:
Hi,
I was wondering if there was already some code, or plans to incorporate tests for multiple comparisons (FDR BY/BH, holm, bonferroni, etc) as part of the gl.report.ld function for linkage disequilibrium?

I was going to try to take the output from gl.report.ld and use other R packages/functions to do this, but wanted to double check this wasn't already a thing in dartR that I wasn't aware of.

Thank you!
Nikki

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: Linkage Disequilibrium - tests for multiple comparison
parts:
Hi Nikki,

Correction for multiple comparisons is not yet implemented in gl.report.ld, we have already put your request in our to-do list. In the meantime you can use the code below.
You can check the correction methods available using:
> ?stats::p.adjust

library(dartR)
test <- gl.filter.callrate(platypus.gl,threshold = 1)
test <- gl.filter.maf(test,threshold = 0.05)
test <- gl.subsample.loci(test,n=20)
res <- gl.report.ld(test)
res$p_corrected <- stats::p.adjust(res$p, method = "bonferroni")

Cheers,
Luis
